report: SHORTLIST-16 deep-third census REVERT (ops#348 defect 4, ops#357)
rights: METHOD AND COUNTS ONLY. The corpus is derivative-cleared-pending and password-gated; it lives on mini and no corpus text, excerpt, transcript, rationale or clip address appears in this repository (ADR-0039 — nwp/nwp is publicly mirrored).

what_happened.summary: Every one of the 16 census partitions WAS adversarially verified, but the coordinating workflow serialised the verdicts inline with a 6,000-character truncation. One verdict survived the cut (d4-01 — a FAIL, excluded); the other fifteen were applied on an assertion. Written to disk and read back, 14 of those 15 were FAILs.
what_happened.mechanism_in_the_two_fully_readable_fail: incumbent bias: the displaced moment's LONGEST view (best_text) described as if it were its ONLY emittable view, an error that fired exclusively in KEEP_DEEP's favour (in d4-02, 9/9 mismatched duration figures sat in KEEP_DEEP reasons, 0 in SWAP reasons)
what_happened.detail_loss: for 13 of the 14 failed partitions only the pass/fail flag survived the truncation; their finding counts are recorded as null, and null is not zero

the_revert.rule: rejected judgements are not applied, in either direction — the treatment d4-01 already received
the_revert.restoration: each reverted deep row restored byte-identical to the pre-census backup and verified field-for-field; completeness asserted against applied.json and the backup, never against a row's own marker

gate.rule: prove it can REFUSE before trusting it to pass

holes_found_in_the_previous_gate_by_corr.H1: the 420 s ceiling was decorative — it compared a SELF-DECLARED duration_s against 420; a row emitting a real 1,199.3 s window while declaring 180.0 passed GREEN. Now measured from the pool's own start/end, and the declared field must agree.
holes_found_in_the_previous_gate_by_corr.H2: a swap from a rejected partition could stand — the gate had no notion of which partitions were verified
holes_found_in_the_previous_gate_by_corr.H3: an unreverted swap could hide by stripping its own census_swap marker

gate.red_proof: 12/12 deliberate corruptions refused, plus a start==0.0 control that must NOT be flagged (the previous red proof's own bug class); exits 2 CANNOT-VERIFY on an absent verdicts file, wrong verdict count, or unreadable clip
gate.note: the briefing predicted 'expect to find something similar' — it was found three times

survival_rate.why: the censused 31.0% [27.6, 34.7] rested on judgements of which 15/16 partitions failed adversarial verification, every examined failure in the direction of keeping the incumbent deep row; it is an over-estimate of unknown size
survival_rate.only_verified_figure: d4-14: 16 of 40 contested rows kept (40%), 24 swapped — 40 rows, too few to generalise
survival_rate.honest_statement: the survival rate of the deep third is UNKNOWN; both machine attempts to measure it (40-row sample, full census) were biased toward the incumbent

what_is_owed.artefact: mini:~/clip-pool/shortlist/contested-pairs.jsonl (sha256 6ad912d62ba9696557c1fc76d7770d6ca71a6aa8de5546564e45d435e73f38a0) — one object per contested deep row of the 15 rejected partitions: the kept row and the corroborated in-window alternate, each with address, duration and agreeing sources
what_is_owed.designated_follow_up: the nwc_clip_review UI — the human author sees both and chooses; the off-list telemetry records the choice as the first honest evaluation signal
what_is_owed.policy: SETTLED: no further machine judging rounds on these rows. The KEEP-vs-SWAP call is the fine-grained comparative pick the judge-consistency experiment measured as unreliable (set agreement 0.81, pick agreement 0.68, 95% CI [0.404, 0.950]).
what_is_owed.checker: contested-pairs verified against the artefact and pool (609/609, applied-then-reverted identity 303/303) by a checker with its own 6/6 red proof

orchestration_bug.defect: verdicts existed only inline; the serialiser truncated at 6,000 characters silently; the applier read absence of a verdict as a pass
fixes: verdicts are written to disk BEFORE they are acted on and read back with the count asserted
a serialiser that drops records must announce it
a partition with no readable verdict is NOT applied — fail closed, the same treatment the one readable FAIL received
